name: App Development
description: Building mobile apps: UI, state, persistence, networking and shipping to the stores.

nodes.name: Mobile platforms
nodes.desc: iOS and Android, native versus cross-platform (Flutter, React Native), and how apps are packaged and run.

nodes.name: App language
nodes.desc: Getting fluent in the language of your stack: Kotlin, Swift, Dart or TypeScript.

nodes.name: Tooling & emulators
nodes.desc: IDEs, simulators and emulators, debugging, and running on a real device.

nodes.name: Mobile UI
nodes.desc: Declarative UI, widgets and components, layout and styling.

nodes.name: Lists & layouts
nodes.desc: Scrolling lists, grids, adaptive layouts for phones and tablets.

nodes.name: Navigation
nodes.desc: Screens, stacks, tabs, passing arguments and deep links.

nodes.name: Theming & a11y
nodes.desc: Design systems, dark mode, dynamic type and screen readers.

nodes.name: Todo app
nodes.desc: Build a multi-screen todo app with lists, navigation and a polished theme.

nodes.name: App state
nodes.desc: Local versus shared state, state hoisting, view models and unidirectional data flow.

nodes.name: App lifecycle
nodes.desc: Foreground, background and process death; saving and restoring state.

nodes.name: Local storage
nodes.desc: Key-value preferences, files and on-device SQL databases (SQLite, Room, Core Data).

nodes.name: Async & threads
nodes.desc: Keeping the main thread free: coroutines, async/await and background work.

nodes.name: Notes app
nodes.desc: Build a notes app with search and on-device persistence that survives restarts.

nodes.name: Networking
nodes.desc: Calling REST APIs, JSON parsing, error handling and loading states.

nodes.name: Sign-in & security
nodes.desc: Login flows, secure token storage and OAuth on mobile.

nodes.name: Offline & sync
nodes.desc: Caching responses, offline-first design, and syncing local data with a server.

nodes.name: Weather app
nodes.desc: Build a weather app that fetches forecasts from a public API, caches them for offline use, and handles errors gracefully.

nodes.name: Device features
nodes.desc: Permissions, camera, location and sensors.

nodes.name: Notifications
nodes.desc: Local and push notifications and background tasks.

nodes.name: Testing & perf
nodes.desc: Unit and UI tests, profiling, startup time and smooth scrolling.

nodes.name: Publishing
nodes.desc: Signing, store listings, review guidelines, releases and crash reporting.

nodes.name: Capstone app
nodes.desc: Design, build and publish (to a test track) an app with sign-in, a backend API, offline support and notifications.
